body.nk-career-portal, body.ncd.nk-career-portal {
font-family: Poppins, sans-serif;
font-size: 14px;
}


/* Header Styles */
.nk-career-portal .content .info-container h2{
    font-family: Poppins, sans-serif;
    font-weight: 400;
    font-size: 20px;
    letter-spacing: 2.5px;
    text-align: center;
    text-transform: uppercase;
}
.nk-career-portal.custom-page-class-jobs-list .content .info-container h3{
    font-family: Teko, sans-serif;
    font-size: 140px;
    text-align: center;
    text-transform: uppercase;
}
.nk-career-portal .header-cover-image{
position: absolute;
}
.nk-career-portal .header-cover-image .overlay{
opacity: 0;
}
.nk-career-portal #language{
display:none;
}
.nk-career-portal nav  {
font-family : Poppins, sans-serif;
font-size: 16px;
font-weight: 600;
letter-spacing: 1px;
line-height: 28.8px;
text-align: center;
text-transform: uppercase;
}

.nk-career-portal .white-left-logo .navbar .container{
        padding: 0px 15px;
}
.nk-career-portal h1.brand img{
width: 180px;
}
.nk-career-portal .white-left-logo .navbar .container h1.brand{
margin-top: 10px;
}

.nk-career-portal .white-left-logo .navbar ul.nav{
    margin: 0;
}
.nk-career-portal .white-left-logo .navbar-collapse{
    max-width: 80%;
}
.navbar .container ul.nav{
    margin-left: 60px;
}
.navbar .container ul.nav li {
    padding: 12px 10px;
}
.navbar .container ul.nav li:hover {
   background-color: #fff;
   color: green;
}
.nk-career-portal .white-left-logo .navbar .container ul.nav li:hover a{
    color:#171e3b;
}
#language a{
color: #F5F5F5;
font-weight: 300;
}
#language a:hover{
color: #0077b5;
}
@media (min-width:768px) {
 .nk-career-portal .white-left-logo .navbar .container {
display:flex;
}
}
@media (max-width:1200px) {
.nk-career-portal .content .info-container h2{
    font-size: 15px;
}
.nk-career-portal .content .info-container h3{
    font-size: 90px;
}
}
/* Footer Styles */
footer {
    background-color: rgb(246, 248, 250);
    text-align: left;
    font-family: 'Poppins', sans-serif;
    bottom:0;
    color: #424860;
    font-weight: 500;
}
footer .fl-module-content{
    margin-top: 20px;
    margin-right: 20px;
    margin-bottom: 20px;
    margin-left: 20px;
}

    padding: 50px 0;
}

footer .fl-col {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: center;
   /* flex-wrap: wrap;*/
}

    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    width: 100%;
    max-width: 1200px;
    margin: 0 auto;
}

footer .fl-col {
    flex: 1;
    min-width: 200px;
    margin: 20px;
}

footer .fl-col-small {
    flex: 1;
}

/* Footer Headings */
footer .fl-heading {
    font-size: 18px;
    margin-bottom: 15px;
    font-family: Poppins, sans-serif;
    font-weight: 700;
    letter-spacing: 0.4px;
    text-transform: uppercase;
}

footer .fl-heading a {
    text-decoration: none;
    color: #424860;
}

footer .fl-heading-text {
    font-weight: bold;
}

/* Footer Links */
footer .fl-node-5f0444be39ff3 .fl-rich-text a {
    text-decoration: none;
    font-size: 12px;
    color: #424860;
    font-size: 12px;
    line-height: 2.5;
}

footer .fl-rich-text a:hover {
    color: #129bf0;
    text-decoration: none;
}

footer .fl-icon-wrap {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    margin-top: 20px;
    justify-content: center;
    padding-bottom: 10px;
}

footer .fl-icon {
    margin-right: 10px;
    display: table-cell;
    vertical-align: middle;
}

footer .fl-icon em {
    font-size: 15px;
     color: #f6f7f9;
}
footer .fl-icon-border {
  background-color: #424860;
    border-radius: 50%;
    padding: 14px;
    height: 12px;
    width: 12px;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
}
footer .fl-icon-border:hover {
  background-color: #337ab7;
}
footer .fl-icon a {
    font-size: 24px;
}
  footer .fl-node-5f044b3c61bd7 .fl-icon i {
font-size: 30px;
}
footer .fl-icon-text {
    font-size: 13px;
}
footer .fl-icon-text p {
    margin: 0;
}

footer .fl-photo-img-svg svg{
     fill: #424860;
     width:180px
}

footer .fl-node-5f0444be39ff1{
    margin-top: 0px;
    margin-bottom: 0px;
}
footer .fl-row-content {
    max-width: 1200px;
    margin: 0 auto;
    text-align: left;
}

    color: #999;
    text-decoration: none;
}

footer .fl-module-rich-text a:hover {
    color: #0077b5;
}
